steps_basic.title: Choose a Pet sprite
steps_basic.instruction: Choose a Pet sprite (or keep the cat and rename it Pet).
steps_basic.hint: Click sprite icon in bottom right to choose from library.

steps_basic.title: Add click event
steps_basic.instruction: Click Buddy so it is selected. Events → drag 'when this sprite clicked' into the coding area.
steps_basic.hint: Events category → when this sprite clicked

steps_basic.title: Make pet talk
steps_basic.instruction: Looks → drag 'say [Hello! I am your pet!] for (2) seconds' and snap it under the event.
steps_basic.blocks_text:
when this sprite clicked
say [Hello! I am your pet!] for (2) seconds

steps_basic.title: Test your pet
steps_basic.instruction: Click the pet on the stage to test (pet should speak).
steps_basic.hint: Click on the pet in the stage area.
steps_basic.blocks_text:
when this sprite clicked
say [Hello! I am your pet!] for (2) seconds

steps_standard.title: Do BASIC first
steps_standard.instruction: Complete BASIC level before starting STANDARD.
steps_standard.hint: Make sure basic pet talking works.

steps_standard.title: Make 'mood' variable
steps_standard.instruction: Variables → Make a Variable → name it 'mood' (for all sprites).

steps_standard.title: Set happy mood on start
steps_standard.instruction: Pet: when green flag clicked → set mood to [happy] and switch to happy costume.
steps_standard.hint: You may need to add or duplicate costumes in the Costumes tab.
steps_standard.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [mood v] to [happy]
switch costume to [happy v]

steps_standard.title: Make pet get hungry
steps_standard.instruction: Control → forever: wait (10) seconds → set mood to [hungry] → switch to hungry costume → say 'I'm hungry!' for 2 seconds.
steps_standard.hint: Control → forever. Put all blocks inside the forever loop.
steps_standard.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [mood v] to [happy]
switch costume to [happy v]
forever
  wait (10) seconds
  set [mood v] to [hungry]
  switch costume to [hungry v]
  say [I'm hungry!] for (2) seconds

steps_standard.title: Add Food button sprite
steps_standard.instruction: Add a new sprite for Food (use a food icon or draw one). This will be your feeding button.
steps_standard.hint: Click sprite icon → choose food sprite or paint one.

steps_standard.title: Food button broadcasts FEED
steps_standard.instruction: Click the Food sprite. Add 'when this sprite clicked' and 'broadcast FEED'.
steps_standard.hint: Events → when this sprite clicked. Events → broadcast → new message → FEED
steps_standard.blocks_text:
when this sprite clicked
broadcast [FEED v]

steps_standard.title: Pet receives FEED
steps_standard.instruction: Click Pet sprite. Add 'when I receive FEED', set mood to happy, switch costume to happy, say 'Yum!' for 1 second.
steps_standard.hint: Code on Pet sprite, not Food sprite!
steps_standard.blocks_text:
when I receive [FEED v]
set [mood v] to [happy]
switch costume to [happy v]
say [Yum!] for (1) seconds

steps_standard.title: Test your smart pet
steps_standard.instruction: Test: start → wait → pet becomes hungry → click Food button to recover.
steps_standard.hint: Pet should cycle: happy → hungry (after 10s) → happy (when fed) → hungry again...

steps_advanced.title: Do STANDARD first
steps_advanced.instruction: Complete STANDARD level before starting ADVANCED.
steps_advanced.hint: You should have Pet with mood, Food button, hungry/happy system.

steps_advanced.title: Make 'energy' variable
steps_advanced.instruction: Variables → Make variable 'energy' (for all sprites). Set energy to (10) on green flag.
steps_advanced.hint: Add this at the start of Pet's green flag script.
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [energy v] to (10)
set [mood v] to [happy]
switch costume to [happy v]

steps_advanced.title: Energy decreases over time
steps_advanced.instruction: In Pet forever loop: every (5) seconds change energy by (-1).
steps_advanced.hint: Separate forever loop or add to existing one.
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [energy v] to (10)
forever
  wait (5) seconds
  change [energy v] by (-1)

steps_advanced.title: Pet gets sleepy
steps_advanced.instruction: Control → if then set mood to [sleepy] and switch to sleepy costume and say 'So sleepy...'.
steps_advanced.hint: Inside energy loop: if energy < 3 then become sleepy.
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [energy v] to (10)
forever
  wait (5) seconds
  change [energy v] by (-1)
  if <(energy) < (3)> then
    set [mood v] to [sleepy]
    switch costume to [sleepy v]
    say [So sleepy...] for (2) seconds

steps_advanced.title: Add Sleep button sprite
steps_advanced.instruction: Add Sleep Button sprite (bed/pillow/moon icon). When clicked → broadcast SLEEP.
steps_advanced.hint: New sprite → when this sprite clicked → broadcast SLEEP
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
when this sprite clicked
broadcast [SLEEP v]

steps_advanced.title: Pet receives SLEEP
steps_advanced.instruction: Pet: when I receive SLEEP → set energy to (10) → set mood to [happy] → switch costume happy.
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
when I receive [SLEEP v]
set [energy v] to (10)
set [mood v] to [happy]
switch costume to [happy v]

steps_advanced.title: Show energy meter (optional)
steps_advanced.instruction: Right-click energy variable on stage and choose 'large readout' or 'slider' to display it visually.
steps_advanced.hint: This helps players see energy level.

steps_advanced.title: Test complete pet system
steps_advanced.instruction: Test: start → wait → pet gets hungry, then sleepy. Feed it and let it sleep. Does everything work?
steps_advanced.hint: Pet should have: hunger (10s), energy (5s drain), feeding, sleeping!
